notes.title: New functionality with Tobii Eye tracking
notes.content:
[img]http://moondrop.no/files/amphora/amphora_eyex.gif[/img]

Today we have updated Amphora with support for Tobii EyeX! The game will react to your eyes for an enhanced gameplay experience. Eye tracking is available on some high-end laptops and as a standalone device you can use anywhere. You can read more about it following this link: [url=http://www.tobii.com/xperience/]http://www.tobii.com/xperience/[/url]

Only available for Windows at present time.

[h1]What eye tracking adds to Amphora[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Extended View.[/b] Move the image on the screen simply by looking to the right or left.
[*][b]Eye Adaptation.[/b] When you gaze at different places on the screen, light effects will automatically activate to highlight your focal point.
[*][b]Affect Environment.[/b] Look at the butterflies that appear in each level to make them fly away. They will gather in the menu screen to show your progress.
[*][b]Gaze Tracking.[/b] The mystical smoke that follows you throughout the game follows the movement of your eyes. Discover the important objects with your gaze.
[/list]

[img]http://moondrop.no/files/amphora/amphora_eyex_butterfly.gif[/img]

notes.title: Amphora now available on Mac! (Repost)
notes.content:
[b]Note: The previous announcement was accidently deleted, we apologize for the inconvenience.[/b]

Today we are happy to announce that Amphora has been released for Mac. If you already have bought Amphora you will automatically have it available on both Windows and Mac. [strike]If you haven’t this is a good time as we are celebrating with a 25% discount![/strike] (Note: sale has ended)

We have also added Steam Trading Cards. When playing Amphora you will receive cards that you can craft into Badges, Backgrounds and Emoticons. 

[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/9131/amphora/steam/steamicons.png[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes (June 29 2015)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Amphora now available on Mac
[*]Added Polish localization
[*]Added trading cards and badges
[/list]

notes.title: Amphora Update Released
notes.content:
An update to Amphora has been released!

We listened to a lot of your feedback and added better conveyance to some levels to make a better experience. We also fixed some bugs in the process.

Thanks for all your support and kind words.

[h1]Patch Notes (November 28 2014)[/h1]
[list]
[*]Bath Level - tweaked for a better experience
[*]Sheep Level - puzzle changed slightly
[*]Roast Level - puzzle changed slightly
[*]Tide Level - added element for conveyance
[*]Cliff Level - added element for conveyance
[*]Increased physics iterations to make it more stable
[*]Game will now run in offline mode
[*]Many small bugs fixed
[/list]
